title: ActionRun
description: One execution of a declared Action. Edges: performed-on -> targets, produced -> created or changed nodes/edges.

actor.description: who or what ran it; agent id, user, pipeline

inputs.description: input name -> value; checked against the action's declared inputs when the ontology is given (design.md 16)

result.description: what the action returned; checked against the action's declared returns.type when the ontology is given (design.md 16)
